name: triplefind-arena
description: Real-time multiplayer TripleFind: authoritative server, event-sourced matches, replays and an Elo ladder.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/protocol && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/client && tsc -p tools/loadtest
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
